# Bundled phpPgAdmin source

Ceasar 1.0.0 carries the complete phpPgAdmin 7.14.6 source archive so a normal
installation and later package upgrade never download phpPgAdmin from another
project at runtime.

- Upstream project: `hestiacp/phppgadmin`, derived from
  `phppgadmin/phppgadmin`
- Upstream release: `v7.14.6`
- Archive: `phppgadmin-7.14.6.tar.gz`
- SHA-256: `bc39f95a2a4b6127b5770208f40fa6b096e6cd5b169e00a454e02872d9e87e58`
- License: GPL-2.0; the verbatim upstream license is in `LICENSE`

The release archive includes its own source files and license. The separate
license copy beside it keeps the terms reviewable without extracting the
archive.
